# Recompiled game code. Everything in ppc/ and modules/ is generated by
# XenonRecomp from the user's own files and is git-ignored.

set(H3_PPC_COMPILE_OPTIONS
    # Keep float results bit-identical to the original code paths.
    -ffp-contract=off
    -fno-strict-aliasing
    # Generated code is noisy; warnings here aren't actionable.
    -w
    # Report jump table indexes outside their table (debug/switch_check.h).
    "SHELL:-include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/debug/switch_check.h"
)

file(GLOB H3_PPC_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${H3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_recomp.*.cpp
    ${H3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_func_mapping.cpp
)

add_library(H3RecompLib STATIC ${H3_PPC_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(H3RecompLib PUBLIC ${H3_PPC_DIR})

# ppc_context.h pulls in SIMDe through XenonUtils' include paths.
target_link_libraries(H3RecompLib PUBLIC XenonUtils)

target_compile_options(H3RecompLib PRIVATE ${H3_PPC_COMPILE_OPTIONS})

option(H3_TRACE_FIRST_CALLS "Write first_calls.txt: each executable function's first call and its frame (debugging)" OFF)
if (H3_TRACE_FIRST_CALLS)
    target_compile_options(H3RecompLib PRIVATE "SHELL:-include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/debug/first_calls.h")
endif()

# --- DLLs the game loads with XexLoadImage ----------------------------------
#
# Each one is recompiled separately into modules/<name>/ (tools/recompile.sh)
# and becomes its own library. Two things make them coexist with the
# executable:
#
#  - Every module's generated code finds indirect call targets through
#    PPC_LOOKUP_FUNC, whose table address comes from ppc_config.h. Forcing
#    the executable's ppc_config.h in (its include guard then hides the
#    module's own) gives all modules one function table, so calls between
#    modules work in both directions. ppc_config.h only feeds that macro.
#  - XenonRecomp always names the mapping array PPCFuncMappings; it's renamed
#    per module and listed in a generated registry for the runtime.
#
# H3_MODULES ends up as the list of module libraries; H3_MODULE_STUBS as the
# matching import stub object libraries, which the runtime links directly so
# its strong import definitions win.
option(H3_TRACE_MODULE_CALLS "Log every call in the recompiled DLLs (very slow; debugging only)" OFF)

set(H3_MODULES_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules)
set(H3_MODULES "")
set(H3_MODULE_STUBS "")
set(H3_MODULE_DECLS "")
set(H3_MODULE_ENTRIES "")

file(GLOB H3_MODULE_CONFIGS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${H3_MODULES_DIR}/*/ppc_config.h)
foreach(config ${H3_MODULE_CONFIGS})
    get_filename_component(dir ${config} DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(name ${dir} NAME)
    string(MAKE_C_IDENTIFIER ${name} ident)

    file(READ ${config} config_text)
    string(REGEX MATCH "PPC_IMAGE_BASE (0x[0-9A-F]+)" _ "${config_text}")
    set(image_base ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
    string(REGEX MATCH "PPC_IMAGE_SIZE (0x[0-9A-F]+)" _ "${config_text}")
    set(image_size ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})

    file(GLOB sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${dir}/ppc_recomp.*.cpp ${dir}/ppc_func_mapping.cpp)
    # SHELL: keeps CMake from de-duplicating the repeated -include flag.
    set(options ${H3_PPC_COMPILE_OPTIONS} "SHELL:-include ${H3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_config.h")
    if (H3_TRACE_MODULE_CALLS)
        list(APPEND options "SHELL:-include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/debug/trace_calls.h")
    endif()
    set(mappings PPCFuncMappings_${ident})

    add_library(H3Module_${ident} STATIC ${sources})
    target_include_directories(H3Module_${ident} PRIVATE ${dir})
    target_link_libraries(H3Module_${ident} PUBLIC XenonUtils)
    target_compile_options(H3Module_${ident} PRIVATE ${options})
    target_compile_definitions(H3Module_${ident} PRIVATE PPCFuncMappings=${mappings})

    add_library(H3ModuleStubs_${ident} OBJECT ${dir}/import_stubs.cpp)
    target_include_directories(H3ModuleStubs_${ident} PRIVATE ${dir} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/H3Recomp)
    target_link_libraries(H3ModuleStubs_${ident} PRIVATE XenonUtils)
    target_compile_options(H3ModuleStubs_${ident} PRIVATE ${options})

    list(APPEND H3_MODULES H3Module_${ident})
    list(APPEND H3_MODULE_STUBS H3ModuleStubs_${ident})
    string(APPEND H3_MODULE_DECLS "extern PPCFuncMapping ${mappings}[];\n")
    string(APPEND H3_MODULE_ENTRIES "    { \"${name}\", ${image_base}, ${image_size}, ${mappings} },\n")
endforeach()

set(H3_MODULES ${H3_MODULES} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(H3_MODULE_STUBS ${H3_MODULE_STUBS} PARENT_SCOPE)

configure_file(recompiled_modules.cpp.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/recompiled_modules.cpp @ONLY)
set(H3_MODULE_REGISTRY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/recompiled_modules.cpp PARENT_SCOPE)
